instruction: Extract the titles from every slide in Dickinson_Slides.pptx and create a Word document 'slide_titles.docx' on the Desktop, listing each title on its own line.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting slide titles from the presentation and saving them to a DOCX file. Evaluator verifies the DOCX contains exactly the 9 slide titles. Verified with Python: extracted 9 slide titles from all slides (first text shape from each slide).
